match.userMessage:
Use Image 1 as the starting frame.
Smooth pan right follows Image 2 as she withdraws her hand from the lifted newspaper, reaches into the flower bucket, and gathers a small bunch of coral ranunculus. She tucks the stems securely beneath her arm while keeping her tote balanced, ending poised to move away from the newsstand. Wind lifts and folds newspaper corners throughout, and a passing bus briefly sweeps red and cream reflections across the scene.

overall_soundscape: city traffic and steady wind along the sidewalk. newspaper pages fluttering and snapping in the wind, stems and flowers rustling as Image 2 gathers them, bus rolling past with a low engine rumble. No BGM, no music. Generate only dialogue, environmental sounds, and action sounds.

summary:
[keyframe completion + reference generation] The 6-second video starts on <Picture 1>, then pans right to show <Subject 1> releasing the newspaper she was holding into the <Subject 2> rack, reaching into the flower bucket, and gathering a small bunch of coral ranunculus into the fold of her arm, ending poised to walk off the sidewalk.

<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved, using <Picture 2> for her face, hair, turtleneck, trousers, sunglasses-on-head, and beige-tote styling.

detailed_description:
A cinematic, natural-day, 16:9 street-life documentary shot with shallow depth, soft warm sunlight, and a clean modern city feel.

[Shot 1] The frame opens on <Picture 1>: <Subject 1> stands in front of <Subject 2>, right arm extended toward the open glass newspaper rack, one open newspaper raised and reading; a red-and-cream transit bus is visible on the street behind to the right; a galvanized metal bucket of coral ranunculus sits on the sidewalk beside the kiosk; the black kiosk sign above reads "NEWSSTAND"; bright daylight, gentle city traffic in the background. The camera performs a small-amplitude Pan Right at medium speed, the bus passing by the right edge casting a soft red-and-cream light sweep across the scene; newspaper corners inside the rack lift and snap in the wind.

[Shot 2] At 00:02.000, the pan continues and <Subject 1> smoothly withdraws her hand from the lifted newspaper, letting the paper drop back into the rack with a soft rustle; her gaze shifts down toward the bucket; the camera performs a small-amplitude Push In combined with continued Pan Right at slow speed to follow her hand reaching into the flower bucket; she gathers a small bunch of coral ranunculus, stems and petals brushing softly against her fingers; the beige tote stays balanced over her shoulder.

[Shot 3] At 00:04.000, the shot tightens slightly as <Subject 1> tucks the gathered stems securely beneath her left arm beside the beige tote, adjusting for balance with a small, confident motion; the running bus is now mostly out of frame, its low rumble fading; the camera performs a very small-amplitude Tracking Shot moving right with her, keeping her centered; she turns her body slightly away from the newsstand, poised to step off the kiosk apron; a final snap of paper corners and a soft breeze over the ranunculus close the shot.

overall_soundscape: Steady city-sidewalk ambience with low background traffic, a light wind lifting and snapping newspaper corners in the rack, a soft rustle of stems and petals as <Subject 1> gathers the coral ranunculus, and a low rolling-bus engine rumble briefly passing through the scene.
